name: Moire
description: Two rulings laid over each other a few degrees apart, so the beat between them draws its own pattern.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 5%, transparent 5% 11%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 5%, transparent 5% 11%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(@pick(6deg, 84deg, 96deg), #000 0 5%, transparent 5% 11%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(@pick(6deg, 84deg, 96deg), #000 0 5%, transparent 5% 11%); opacity: 0.75; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
